title: Pilot features
description: A pale cyan band framed by hairlines: a centred semibold heading and roomy lede, then three rows that alternate a rounded, dot-textured cyan media card with a column holding a large line icon, a medium-weight title and a short line of copy; it ends on a big handwritten closing line with a cyan brush stroke. On phones each row stacks centred: icon, title, copy, then the card.
notes: the band is accent at 20% and the cards are solid accent, so it follows the theme's accent colour
